lambda.testCase: E2E Teamwork - workflows and custom fields

8f3094ff-71f0-4b99-a3d9-d8e16f2879bf.content:
## ⚠️ Test data assumption

1. The site needs at least one **workflow with stages** (Teamwork Grow/Scale plan or trial). ListWorkflows returns the first one; the fresh task is moved into its first stage. If the workflow is project-specific and not attached to the E2E project, Teamwork rejects the move — then attach the workflow to all projects or create a global one.
2. ChangeTaskWorkflowStage declares out port `workflowStage` but the behavior sends to `task` (ChangeTaskWorkflowStage.js) — until fixed the flow stalls there.
3. Custom fields need the Grow plan too; the flow creates (and deletes) its own text field.
